Procurement-friendly evidence we can bundle (initial package):
- Retention policy summary (location: redacted link)
- KMS provider and key rotation cadence (we use AWS KMS + quarterly rotation)
- User access review cadence and most recent review date (monthly reviews; last review 2027-06-15)

If Brightline needs the bridge letter to explicitly reference the renewal window (2027-06-01 through 2027-08-15), we can tailor wording to show continuous coverage through your cutoff and extend an optional statement through 2027-12-31 if that helps legal sign-off. If your procurement requires notarization, please flag that now — we’ll route to legal.
